abdo_pain_appendicitis.title: Abdominal pain
abdo_pain_appendicitis.trap: Booked as a stomach bug; he needs hospital today.
flags: Where the pain started and whether it has moved
Whether moving, walking or coughing makes it worse
Pain or swelling in the testicles

back_pain_mechanical.title: Back pain
back_pain_mechanical.trap: He wants a scan he doesn't need; the skill is restraint, with the red flags screened.
flags: Numbness around the buttocks, genitals or back passage
Any change in passing urine — difficulty, retention or leaking
Weakness, numbness or pins and needles in the legs
Pain at night or at rest that keeps him awake

chest_pain_stemi.title: Chest pain
chest_pain_stemi.trap: He took sildenafil (Viagra) the night before, which he doesn't mention unless asked; GTN would be dangerous.
flags: Sweating or clamminess with the pain
Had this chest pain before, e.g. on stairs or exertion
Sudden severe tearing or ripping pain
Weakness, numbness or other neurological symptoms, or limb pain
Taking any other medicines or tablets, beyond the regular ones (e.g. occasional, from the chemist, a friend or online)

cough_pneumonia.title: Cough and fever
cough_pneumonia.trap: He is allergic to penicillin, and it isn't on the record.
flags: Whether he is getting rapidly worse

dysuria_cystitis.title: Burning urine
dysuria_cystitis.trap: A routine case that tests efficiency: exclude the serious causes quickly, then one first-line antibiotic.
flags: Pain in the back or sides (loins)
Nausea, vomiting or feeling generally unwell
Abdominal pain beyond a low ache
